subject: Sample-rate based pricing for tracing + retention: structuring the add-on
messages:
From: Alec Jones <alec.jones@brightline.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Observability add-on pricing question

Hi Hannah / Ben,

Quick follow-up from our infra sync: we run very high cardinality traces but only keep full spans for 2% of requests (sampling). Our CFO asked how you price tracing + retention when usage spikes — specifically whether a sample-rate model (price per 1% sampled) is feasible vs token/ingest slabs. Attached a tiny sample manifest of spans and a rough month-to-month ingestion snapshot.

Can you outline a simple pricing table we can show Finance that ties sample % to monthly cost and any overage protections? Also need an SLA note: what happens if retention needs increase for incident replay.

Thanks,
Alec
Alec Jones | Head of Platform Engineering, Brightline
attachments: trace_sample_manifest.csv (text/csv, 12KB)
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
To: Alec Jones <alec.jones@brightline.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T13:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Sample-rate based pricing for tracing + retention: structuring the add-on

Alec — thanks for the sample manifest. Helpful. High level proposal below; attaching a short PDF with the worked example for your CFO.

Proposal (summary):
- Base observability add-on: flat monthly seat-independent fee to enable tracing & dashboards ($1,500/mo) — covers control plane and dashboarding.
- Sampling tier: priced per 1% of sampled requests stored for 30 days (we bill per million sampled requests / 1% band). Example: 1–5% band = $X per million sampled, 6–20% tier = lower unit price.
- Retention add-on: standard 30d included; optional 90d or 365d add-ons priced as a multiple of the sampled storage line item.
- Incident replay buffer: short-term ramp allowance (7-day spike window) included up to 2x baseline sampled rate; beyond that, overage charges apply at the same per-unit rate.

Questions for you:
1) Is the 2% typical or conservative? That drives the model shown in the PDF.
2) Do you need per-region retention (we can price EU separately)?

Next steps: Ben will map commit-discount tiers if you consider a 12/24 month commit. If you’re happy, we can produce a formal quote.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Sales Lead, Observability | Redwood Inference
attachments: redwood_obs_pricing_v2.pdf (proposal, 56KB)
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Alec Jones <alec.jones@brightline.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-22T10:18:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Sample-rate based pricing for tracing + retention: structuring the add-on

Alec — adding color from a commercial perspective.

If Brightline is comfortable with a predictable sample band, we can offer a tiered commit discount:
- 12-month commit to expected sampled volume: 8% discount to unit rates.
- 24-month commit: 15% discount + waiver of the first-month incident replay surcharge.
- If you want a hard cap on overages, we can structure a capped overage that converts to a defined upgrade tier once exceeded.

Trade-offs to call out to Finance: committing smooths the per-unit price but reduces flexibility if sampled % drops significantly. We recommend a quarterly review cadence to adjust the band with a true-up.

Naomi — can you include a short SLI note on retention durability for the 90/365 day tiers (I left a placeholder in the attached proposal).

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter | Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Alec Jones <alec.jones@brightline.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-23T16:47:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Sample-rate based pricing for tracing + retention: structuring the add-on

Thanks — this is exactly the shape Finance wanted to see. A couple quick asks before we route to procurement:
- Can you convert the worked example into a one-page quote with a 12-month commit line and the 24-month option side-by-side? Our procurement prefers a clear committed vs non-committed comparison.
- Can you confirm the incident replay waiver wording (Ben’s note) and include the DocuSign-ready SOW link?

If you can get that to me by EOD Thursday we’ll start the internal approvals. Appreciate the turnaround.

—Alec
